source.description: fix_proof is the server's pre-merge Fix Proof Guard (Phase Workflows Specification, fix-proof); its finding types are fix_red_missing, fix_test_changed (non-blocking), and fix_proof_indeterminate. added_lines is the server's pre-merge Added-Line Scan (Phase Workflows Specification, added-line-scan); its finding types are hidden_characters, model_instruction (non-blocking), credential_shaped, and added_lines_indeterminate. dependency_delta is the server's pre-merge Dependency Delta Check (Phase Workflows Specification, dependency-delta); its finding types are undeclared_dependency and dependency_delta_indeterminate. ci is a failed CI check filed by ci-verify (Phase Workflows Specification, step 22); it carries ci_failure.

provider.description: Required (non-null) iff source == analysis: the id of the code analysis provider that reported the finding (for example sonar), the same id as in its analysis result record; null otherwise. No source value names a single analysis provider.

ci_failure.description: Required (non-null) iff source == ci; null otherwise.

check_name.description: Provider name of the failed check or pipeline job.

failure_kind.description: From the check's log, parsed by the PM-IMPL-6 build output parsers; unknown when no parser recognises the log or the log is unreadable; unknown is handled fail-closed: the finding of a failed required check is blocking whatever its kind.

required_check.description: Whether the check is in the derived required_checks of the base branch; a non-required check is filed with blocking false.

phase.description: Phase the finding was filed against: the phase value of the phase sub-workflow on the call stack of the filing transition (Phases as Sub-Workflows); required for qgate findings. A write addressed to a phase the plan has left is refused with phase_closed.

queue_task_id.description: The queue task whose submit filed the finding (Queue Task Record); null for findings the server files itself. Feeds the spend class findings_only.

batch_id.description: The screening batch (batch-v1) of the gather or source firing that ingested the finding's external text; null for a finding without external text (server-filed, self_review, qgate).

screen.description: Level-2 screen of the finding's external text (summary and body), taken from the scope's screen verdict cache or the batch's screener job; null when the finding has no external text.

verdict.description: A missing, extra, or unparseable verdict item is recorded suspicious (fail-closed).

withheld.description: true iff verdict is suspicious: the text is never delivered to a model; only the structured fields (author, file, line, kind) and 'withheld: flagged by screener' are rendered, and the finding stays pending until a met waiver of its gate or the unit's fallback.

spans.description: Flagged spans of a suspicious text; operator and audit data only.

requirement_refs.description: Requirement ids (PM-<AREA>-<N>) or specification anchors the finding bears on; set by triage and validated by the server against the registry of the binary.

submitted_severity.description: The severity the producer submitted, kept when the security calibration capped it (source security_audit); null otherwise.

security.description: Calibration facts of a security_audit finding, required for that source and null for every other; the server caps severity from them (link:../phase-workflows/05-finalize-review-metrics-descriptor.adoc#security-audit-calibration[Phase Workflows § Security Audit Calibration])

ingress.description: Where attacker-controlled data enters on the path to the flaw.

cap_rule.description: Server-written: the cap-table rule that lowered the severity, null when none applied.

blocking.description: Set at write time from the producer's declared class for this finding type; later changed only by triage.

disposition.description: The triage disposition submitted by the triage job of the gather firing (submit:triage-groups: one disposition per (domain, rule_id) group, with per-finding exceptions); written per finding by the server.

suppress_reason.description: Closed reason of a SUPPRESS disposition, submitted with it (see Closed Suppression Reason); null for every other disposition. claim_refuted iff resolution is rejected.

introduced_by.description: Server-written at filing: the remediation fix whose changed lines the finding is located in (see Fix Attribution); null for a finding on lines no fix of the plan changed, and for an unlocated finding.

round.description: The remediation round (or loop-back iteration) whose fix changed the lines.

resolution.description: Server-written outcome of the finding (see Server-Written Resolution); never a link parameter. Mirrors plan-marshall's resolution vocabulary.

scope_class.description: Server-classified at triage: whether file_path lies in the plan's effective footprint; unlocated when the finding names no path.

carried_to.description: Set when a finding still pending after the merge is carried out of the plan.

body.description: Promoted full text of the finding (review comment text, Sonar message), stored as the level-1 validator cleaned it (every change reported) and treated as untrusted content; delivered only while screen.withheld is false.

author.description: Structured provider author login of a review comment; never parsed from comment text.

bot_kind.description: Review-bot registry key resolved from author (<<review-bot-registry>>).

raised_at_head.description: HEAD the finding was raised against; required for self_review, qgate, code_review, security_audit, arch_gate, and ci findings (for ci the head SHA of the checked run).

reading.description: Which review-code task of a round with two readings filed the finding (Phase Workflows Specification, second-code-reading); null otherwise.

reviewed_commit_sha.description: Commit the reviewer covered, taken only from provider evidence (<<review-participation>>); null when the evidence names no commit.

edit_marker.description: Provider updated_at of the ingested comment when it differs from its created_at.

ref.description: file:line, job id, or URL the resolution rests on.

claim_refuted.description: True when the evidence refutes the finding's claim (refutation sub-state verdict, or substitute evidence with a concrete ref).

provider_ref.description: Structured external provider coordinates for outbound reply/dismissal transmission.

issue_key.description: The analysis provider's own key of the issue (source == analysis), opaque to the server; with provider it identifies the issue for the responder.

transmit_outcome.description: Outcome of the outbound reply or dismissal for this finding's disposition.

transmit_reason.description: Closed reason for not_sent, skipped_no_address, sent_unresolved, or partial; one vocabulary for every provider (GitHub, GitLab, Sonar), see Transmit Reasons. Null when transmit_outcome is pending or sent.

transmit_disposition.description: The disposition value the last transmission carried; (finding_id, transmit_disposition) is the idempotency key.

responded_at.description: Stamped after the provider accepted the reply, before thread resolution.
